data.fund_type: An open ended scheme replicating/ tracking Nifty 50 index
data.investment_objective: The investment objective of the scheme is to replicate the composition of the Nifty 50 and to generate returns that are commensurate with the performance of the NIFTY 50 Index, subject to tracking errors. However, there is no assurance that the objective of the scheme will be realized
data.asset_allocation: Equity and Equity related securities covered by the Nifty 50 including Derivatives - 95% - 100% - Medium to High (Risk Profile) Debt and Money Market Instruments - 0% - 5% Low to Medium (Risk Profile)
